what.question: What is Amnesty International DAO?
what.answer: A community coordination platform for people organizing human rights work with shared tools, transparent governance, and decentralized resilience.

who.question: Who can join?
who.answer: People and groups who want to coordinate, support, and participate in community-led human rights action.

decisions.question: How are decisions made?
decisions.answer: Communities can use proposals, discussions, and voting windows to make decisions visibly and accountably.

affiliation.question: Is this affiliated with official Amnesty International offices?
affiliation.answer: This concept uses Amnesty-inspired branding and should be governed by the project’s official affiliation and trademark decisions before public launch.

data.question: Is my data safe?
data.answer: The architecture is designed around decentralization, access control, and resilience rather than a single central server.

funded.question: How is this funded?
funded.answer: Communities can coordinate fundraising campaigns and track support transparently.

different.question: What makes this different from other platforms?
different.answer: It combines documents, boards, calendars, proposals, fundraising, and localization in one community-scoped workspace.

started.question: How do I get started?
started.answer: Join the DAO, create or enter a community, then start coordinating work with the shared tools.

cta.title: Human rights need all of us.
cta.body: Join communities around the world building a more just and equal future.
